summary: Multiband compressor and upward expander for mastering and buses: 3 or 4 bands split by linear-phase crossovers (the bands sum back to the input exactly; about 96 ms of latency, reported to NeoBuzz Live) or zero-latency minimum-phase ones (Linkwitz–Riley, the same band shapes), each band with threshold, ratio (above 1:1 compresses, below 1:1 expands upward), attack, release, knee, range, makeup, solo and bypass; the detector linked in stereo or in mid/side; mix and output. With every band at 1:1 and 0 dB it passes the input, delayed by the latency, bit for bit. Use it to control the lows, tame harshness, de-ess, glue a bus or lift the air of a master.

parameters.name: Bands
parameters.description: Three bands (Crossover 1 and 2) or four (all three crossovers)

parameters.name: Crossover 1
parameters.description: Between bands 1 and 2 (Linkwitz–Riley, 24 dB/oct, −6 dB here)

parameters.name: Crossover 2
parameters.description: Between bands 2 and 3 (never below Crossover 1)

parameters.name: Crossover 3
parameters.description: Between bands 3 and 4 with four bands (never below Crossover 2)

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description: Linear: the bands sum back to the input exactly, no phase shift, about 96 ms of latency (reported to NeoBuzz Live). Minimum: zero latency, the same band shapes, the crossovers' phase shift (as an analog crossover's)

parameters.name: Stereo
parameters.description: What each band's detector and gain work on: left and right, or mid and side

parameters.name: Link
parameters.description: 100 %: both channels (or mid and side) get the same gain, from the louder; 0 %: each its own

parameters.name: B1 threshold
parameters.description: Band 1: level where the gain starts to change (the band's peak)

parameters.name: B1 ratio
parameters.description: Band 1: above 1:1 compresses above the threshold (∞: limits); below 1:1 expands upward (0.5:1 doubles the level over the threshold); 1:1 does nothing

parameters.name: B1 attack
parameters.description: Band 1: time to 63 % of a gain change

parameters.name: B1 release
parameters.description: Band 1: time back to 37 % of a gain change

parameters.name: B1 knee
parameters.description: Band 1: width of the soft knee around the threshold

parameters.name: B1 range
parameters.description: Band 1: the most the gain changes, either way

parameters.name: B1 makeup
parameters.description: Band 1: gain after the dynamics (negative cuts the band)

parameters.name: B1 solo
parameters.description: Band 1: hear only the soloed bands (processed, Mix ignored)

parameters.name: B1 bypass
parameters.description: Band 1: pass the band untouched (no dynamics, no makeup)
